purpose: Define how SEIS can move from the planned 20B local compatibility target toward 70B, 150B, 512B AGI research, and larger frontier model research without claiming trained weights, AGI capability, runtime eligibility, benchmark results, or model ownership before evidence exists.
truthBoundary: Policy and escalation gate only. It does not download models, download datasets, run inference, train, fine-tune, benchmark memory, call providers, execute SSH, deploy infrastructure, publish weights, or claim SEIS owns a trained 20B, 70B, 150B, 512B, AGI, or larger foundation model.
currentAllowedMode: Local Demo and deterministic seed-model lab only

decisionRules.rule: 70B, 150B, 512B, AGI, and larger parameter classes cannot be scoped for runtime until the 20B local compatibility gates produce real evidence.
Missing local model evidence must fall back to SEIS Local Demo and must not silently route to cloud providers.
Any model download, runtime adapter execution, benchmark, provider credential setup, SSH, cloud/GPU provisioning, publication, or deployment requires explicit human approval.
SEIS-owned model claims require dataset provenance, training logs, checkpoints, evaluation reports, safety reports, and model cards.

requiredEvidenceBeforeNext: filled 20B model card with clean-room provenance
filled 20B dataset or benchmark-data card with rights review
20B and 70B gate evidence reviewed and accepted
20B, 70B, 150B, and 300B+ gate evidence reviewed and accepted
all installed AI and sub-agent council review recorded
safety, privacy, budget, and governance approval

requiredGlobalEvidence: training or fine-tuning logs before any training claim
checkpoint governance before any checkpoint claim
model card before any model ownership claim
evaluation report before any benchmark claim
provider and local-only routing disclosure before any live route claim
forbiddenClaims: SEIS has trained a 20B foundation model.
SEIS has trained a 70B foundation model.
SEIS has trained a 150B foundation model.
SEIS has trained a 512B foundation model.
SEIS has benchmarked 20B, 70B, or 150B memory usage.
SEIS has benchmarked 512B or AGI capability.
SEIS can skip 20B evidence and move directly to 70B, 150B, or 512B runtime scope.
A provider API, prompt profile, RAG system, wrapper, quantization, LoRA, adapter, or checkpoint template is a SEIS-owned foundation model.
nextSafeActions: Keep the 20B lane planned-not-validated until model and dataset cards are filled with reviewed evidence.
Keep 70B and 150B route eligibility false until earlier gates produce real evidence.
Expose this policy in Command Center as an escalation gate, not as runtime readiness.
Validate this policy with npm run check:seis-model-frontier-escalation-policy.
